# Driftline

> Driftline helps product managers turn contradictory evidence into a reversible experiment, then reopen the decision when a guardrail breaks.

## Product

Driftline's public Decision Twin connects customer, usage, support, interface, and commitment evidence; compares ship, rollback, segment, and defer; and pauses for named human approval. A measured aggregate outcome can reopen the same decision as a new generation while preserving its lineage.

The adjacent Promise Drift workflow reads a registered source, cites the observed change, maps affected work surfaces and owners, and prepares reversible downstream work. Public examples are preview-only and do not write to external systems.

## Evidence and safety

Every recommendation stays linked to its source evidence. Approval is explicit, outputs are reversible, and technical release proof is available in the product's Technical proof disclosure.
